caption: The drawing depicts an object with a triangular, shield-like shape and a handle, shown in both a three-dimensional perspective and two orthographic views (top and side). The main object has a dark, textured surface, and appears to be made of a solid, possibly metal material. The triangular portion of the object features a raised geometric pattern with symmetrical, leaf-like shapes and a border following the edge of the triangle. The object is supported by three short, cylindrical legs attached underneath. The handle is cylindrical and appears to have a knurled or braided texture, ending in a circular form with a central hollow. A thin border encloses the entire drawing, and there is a small scale below the orthographic views for measurement. The drawing is monochromatic, rendered in shades of black and gray on a light-colored background, with fine pencil or ink detailing. In the bottom left corner, there is a handwritten signature: "Salvatore Botrasso."
title: Flat Iron Holder
